data.body: Patchset 2 CI run 31825202926 was cancelled after 280s once it was irreversibly red, freeing the remaining test/mutation runners. Failure classification: stale-base build failure, not this change. The shallow complexity lock had no merge base and attributed origin/main commit 2c2bf88cfa's unrelated fetcher.py::_build_snapshot to this patchset. origin/main advanced by two commits while the run was active. Rebasing onto current origin/main (39de64871c) made the exact lock command pass with GITHUB_REPOSITORY=navapbc/rebar. Focused 212 tests and make lint/actionlint remain green. Patchset 3 pushed immediately at a4aa3c35b46be5ab41ec5430a93d626d15cc802e.
